title: Russian triangle event as pre-arranged meeting or transfer
place_text: Pacific Ocean off Kamchatka, eastern Russia

tellings.quote: I've come to believe that that was some sort of pre-arranged meeting um for whatever purpose.

plain: A 2018 event over the Pacific Ocean off Kamchatka, in eastern Russia, involving triangle-shaped objects, may have been a planned meeting or handover. Matthew Brown, a guest presented as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels: "I've come to believe that that was some sort of pre-arranged meeting, for whatever purpose." If so, the encounter was arranged in advance by someone rather than happening by chance.
